body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> RIM announced its wireless BlackBerry Presenter module during Digital Experience event at CES 2010, which allows users to make PowerPoint presentations from their BlackBerry phones. Measuring 3.4 x 2.4 x 09 inches, the BlackBerry Presenter supports VGA and S-Video ports. It is expected to be available in the end of January for 199(USD).
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
